label: a
rationale: Criterion 1 (shared machinery). Batches 2 and 3 are the run's whole abstract-algebra category and stay together by the wholeness rule. Batch 1 joins them because its second half is finite-abelian-group structure theory, not arithmetic: prop-jacobi-symbol-on-units-is-a-homomorphism and thm-jacobi-map-kernel-and-square-subgroup compute a homomorphism on (Z/n)^* together with its kernel and the index-two subgroup of unit squares, and thm-unit-square-criterion-modulo-n decomposes squareness prime-power by prime-power over a CRT product — the same internal-direct-product-over-primes argument batch 2 runs as lem-finite-nilpotence-via-normal-sylow-subgroups and thm-sylow-characterizations-of-finite-nilpotence. The Legendre/Euler background batch 1 builds on lives in the multiplicative group of a finite field, and batch 3 is the finite-field batch (thm-perfect-field-characterizations, cor-fields-of-characteristic-zero-and-finite-fields-are-perfect, ex-algebraic-closure-of-a-finite-field, the Frobenius map); batch 2 additionally carries def-integral-element-and-algebraic-integer and cor-rational-algebraic-integers-are-integers, which is number theory sitting inside the algebra batch. The run declares zero cross-batch dependency edges, so an Alpha holding all three is also the only reader who can see batch 1 re-deriving in prose a unit-group or finite-field fact batches 2 and 3 establish, and say so at 6c. Cost accepted: 205 items, the heaviest group. Criterion 3 is not violated, since the large-on-large stack (106 + 72) is forced by category wholeness and batch 1 at 27 items is the second-smallest in the run.

label: b
rationale: Criterion 1 (shared machinery), on two distinct links. Batch 4's Borel half is point-set topology worked through a σ-algebra: def-borel-sigma-algebra generates from the open sets, thm-rational-box-generators-of-the-borel-sigma-algebra-on-rn plays compact sets, open balls and rational boxes against each other, thm-borel-sigma-algebra-of-a-subspace-is-the-trace is the subspace topology, and thm-continuous-preimages-of-borel-sets-are-borel, ex-f-sigma-and-g-delta-sets-are-borel and ex-borel-trace-on-the-cantor-set are all topological statements; batch 5 is the run's topology batch and works exactly that layer (lem-open-quotient-arcs-in-real-line-mod-integers, prop-real-line-mod-integers-is-compact-and-path-connected, prop-real-line-mod-integers-is-hausdorff), so one Alpha checks both uses of the same published Euclidean and quotient topology. Batches 5 and 6 share the plane and its compactness-and-subdivision arguments: lem-goursat-nested-triangle-selection bisects with halving diameters onto a one-point intersection, against subdivision of the interval for path lifting; rem-plane-star-shaped-and-convex-dictionary identifies C with R^2 under the same published Euclidean topology batch 4 requires; and batch 5's degree map is precisely the winding number behind batch 6's cex-holomorphic-function-on-an-annulus-with-nonzero-closed-contour-integral and cex-connected-domain-need-not-be-star-shaped — the failure of simple connectivity seen from the homotopy side and the integration side. That is the clearest cross-reference in the run whose two halves sit in different batches, so it must not cross a group boundary. 107 items.

label: c
rationale: Criterion 1 again, in the negative: category theory is a whole category in one group, and batch 7's machinery — adjunctions, Eilenberg–Moore and Kleisli categories, monadicity and conservativity, the ultrafilter and covariant power-set monads — is not the machinery of any other batch here. Its only contacts elsewhere are analogies rather than shared arguments: thm-monads-on-a-preorder-are-exactly-closure-operators and ex-the-closure-operator-monad-on-a-topological-space rhyme with batch 4's def-generated-sigma-algebra and thm-generated-sigma-algebra-calculus (monotone and idempotent generation), and lem-ultrafilter-pushforward-is-an-ultrafilter rhymes with compactness, but neither is a citation either side needs, and neither would give an Alpha anything to check end to end. Pairing batch 7 with measure theory or with number theory to even out the item counts would have bought balance at the price of breaking one of the two real machinery clusters above, so this group is deliberately a single batch of 67 items. Criterion 2 (fewest edges to everything else) could not discriminate: this run declares no cross-batch dependency edges at all, so every arrangement crosses zero, and the decision rests entirely on machinery.
